reference_cohort_info_part.pre_trained_note: This study used pre-trained normative models from the PCN toolkit (Rutherford et al., refs 13-14) built on approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range: 2-100 years). Local healthy controls (N=122) collected at UAB were used for calibration/transfer of the pre-trained normative reference curves only. As Model Build = Pre-trained, RCI-1 to RCI-7 extraction is not applicable.
reference_cohort_info_part.pre_trained_supporting_text: "Here, we used the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit (version 0.27), a publicly available Python package, for normative modeling of resting state connectivity data. The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100). Healthy control data collected in this project were used for calibration of the normative reference curves"; "The normative models used here likely overrepresent individuals with European ancestry"; "normative reference curves have also been developed for large-scale resting-state brain networks [13]"
